title: Wall Mount Double Glass Shelf 22-Inch Solid Brass Gallery Rail Bathroom Storage | Unlacquered Brass | Allied Brass
description:
Add organized bathroom storage with a wall mount glass shelf designed for daily essentials in Unlacquered Brass, which is a living finish that develops a unique natural patina over time, gaining character and warmth with age. Each piece becomes one-of-a-kind, perfect for those who appreciate authentic materials that tell a story. From the Waverly Place collection, this double glass shelf features 3/8-inch thick tempered glass and a gallery rail that helps keep items in place. Solid brass hardware and concealed screw mounting create a clean, built-in look.

Highlights:
- Unlacquered Brass develops a unique, one-of-a-kind patina over time
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Gallery rail helps secure toiletries, bottles, and décor
- Solid brass hardware supports lasting installation
- Concealed screw wall mount for a neat appearance

Specs:
- Glass dimensions: 22 x 5 Inches
- Overall: 22-Inch L x 5-Inch projection x 8-Inch H
- Weight capacity: 4 lb
- Mounting type: wall mount
- Assembly required: no
- Included: glass shelf and all installation hardware; screw size #8 x 1 1/4
- Coordinates with transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories; part of the waverly place collection
- Multiple designer finish options available
